patients.description: Master patient demographic and enrollment record

visits.description: Clinical visit events tied to patient episodes

episodes.description: Patient care episode lifecycle — SOC through discharge. Primary reporting grain: BRANCH via epi_branchcode.

service_line_id.description: Service line ID (epi_slid): 1=Home Health, 2=Hospice, 3=Private Duty, 25000=Palliative, 25001=Personal Care

care_type.description: Care type (e.g. Routine, Continuous, Respite, General Inpatient)

payor.description: Primary payor source (Medicare, Medicaid, Private Insurance, etc.)

location_id.description: Internal location ID (legacy — use branch_code for reporting)

branches.description: Branch/location master reference — authoritative source for branch name, region, city, and state dimensions

code.description: Branch code — primary key, joins to epi_branchcode

region.description: Geographic region grouping for the branch

city.description: City where the branch is located

service_lines.description: Service line lookup — maps epi_slid to human-readable service line names

name.description: Service line name (HOME HEALTH, HOSPICE, PRIVATE DUTY, etc.)

care_types.description: Care type lookup for hospice and home health level-of-care classification

visit_notes.description: Clinical visit note records linked to patient episodes. Source for documentation compliance and activity KPIs.

visit_date.description: Date and time the visit occurred

signed_datetime.description: Date and time the note was signed by clinician

discipline.description: Clinical discipline (SN, PT, OT, SW, HHA, etc.)

note_type.description: Type of visit note (SOC, Resumption, Recertification, Routine)

billing_line_items.description: Billing line items representing submitted or pending claims. Source for Revenue Cycle KPIs including holds and SLA compliance.

service_date.description: Date of service for the line item

amount.description: Billed dollar amount for the line item

hold_flag.description: 1 = line item is in billing hold, 0 = cleared for submission

hold_days.description: Number of days the line item has been in hold status

claim_status.description: Current claim status (Hold, Submitted, Paid, Denied)

current_census.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate THEN epi.epi_id END)
current_census.description: Active patient count as of a given date

average_daily_census.description: Mean active patients per day over the period

hospice_census_equivalent.expression: SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day,1,@EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END))
hospice_census_equivalent.description: Total hospice patient-days within the reporting period

avg_days_referral_to_soc.description: Mean days from referral to start of care

admissions_within_2_days.expression: COUNT(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, epi.epi_ReferralDate, epi.epi_SocDate) <= 2 THEN 1 END)
admissions_within_2_days.description: Admissions where SOC occurred within 2 days of referral

daily_census.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate <= @AsOfDate AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate) THEN epi.epi_id END)
daily_census.description: Active patient count for a specific calendar date

hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.expression: SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day,1,@EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END)) * @HCE_FACTOR
hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.description: Hospice patient-days by branch weighted by HCE_FACTOR

enterprise_total_hce.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN epi.epi_slid = 2 THEN DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day,1,@EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END) * 1.00 ELSE DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day,1,@EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END) * 0.40 END)
enterprise_total_hce.description: Enterprise HCE — Hospice at 1.00, HH/Palliative at 0.40

billing_holds.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN li.li_hold_flag = 1 THEN li.li_id END)

billing_hold_sla_compliance.expression: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN li.li_hold_flag = 1 AND li.li_hold_days <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN li.li_hold_flag = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) * 100
billing_hold_sla_compliance.description: Percent of billing holds resolved within 5-day SLA

visit_notes_activity.description: Total visit notes entered in the reporting period

visit_note_documentation_compliance.expression: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN vn.vn_completed_flag = 1 AND DATEDIFF(hour, vn.vn_visit_date, vn.vn_signed_datetime) <= 24 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(vn.vn_id), 0) * 100
visit_note_documentation_compliance.description: Percent of visit notes signed within 24 hours of the visit
